{{Top|leg}}
'''Trenton''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Trenton liked using a [[Flame Carbine]] as a secondary weapon, since it was neither a great or bad weapon. Trenton also commented that the [[SonoMax 75]] [[sonic pistol]] was an effective weapon when facing a mob of opponents.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
